items.text: Let it be — Gavin's at 6 HP but unharassed (the goblin doesn't strike first), and he's just poking at edges on his own: three "goblin" refusals and a "Hello goblin" into the dark. That's a parser gap for a building turn, not something a voice from the air should paper over, and he was already answered once tonight. (Noted: Cave Mouth's description still has no memorial line — Chris died before that shipped, so it remains untested.)
